channel.title: NicheExplained
channel.description: NicheExplained publishes clear, accurate explainer articles on niche topics — one a day.

item.title: How Electricity Is Generated and Sold: Spinning Magnets, Units and a Giant Shared Tank
item.description: Almost every power plant just spins a magnet. A plain-English guide to how electricity is made, what a 'unit' really is, and how India buys and sells power.

item.title: The Lindy Effect Explained: Why Old Things Tend to Last Longer
item.description: What the Lindy effect is, where the name comes from, the maths behind it, real examples, and where the rule of thumb breaks down.

item.title: How a Mosquito Works: 6 Tiny Needles, a Breath Detector and Other Surprises
item.description: That itchy bite starts with six tiny needles. A fun, plain-English tour of a mosquito's body, how it finds you, how a bite works, and why only females bite.
